All other final code, cold-load ownership fix, recording, callback probes, seed, route, 20s duration, 60Hz cap and input schedule are identical. This is not an old-build versus new-build FPS comparison.

host.cache_state: Fresh processes; OS and driver caches uncontrolled. Background GPU utilization not measured.

correctness.regression_found: Adding the threaded textured model exposed renderer initialization errors during concurrent immediate cold scene loads in the full headless fixtures; assertions alone had passed.
correctness.fix: Live title preparers register and unregister deterministically. An uncached immediate scene request collects their outstanding owned load before another synchronous resource load, then rechecks cache. No extra request/get, test sleep, headless exclusion or altered geometry.
correctness.focused_proof: Actual delayed-worker test proves unrelated immediate load starts after the owned pending request is collected and freed preparers unregister.

limits: This removes the measured first stairs-preview load spike within these runs; historical intermittent steady-travel stalls were not reproduced or claimed fixed.

The extra existing PackedScene is retained from title preparation instead of first stairs use, adding one bounded queued resource; title readiness can wait for it. The immediate cold-load fallback can wait on already pending title preparation. No blanket startup speedup is claimed.

Initial-window maxima remain134.758–208.087ms across these ten runs. OS/driver cache and background GPU activity were uncontrolled. Small desktop/report activity continued, with no second Godot during timing.
Native machine is RTX3070/i9-11900KF,1920x1080 high Forward+/Vulkan4xMSAA. Broader hardware, cold-cache/Continue matrix, fine callback overhead and human campaign/feel acceptance remain unmeasured.
